_note: Human-accepted archetype names, keyed "<hero_id>:<archetype_id>". Keys starting with _ are notes, not names.
_source: Names a Deadlock player supplied in review. Recorded here so a refit reproduces them literally rather than depending on the naming rule to arrive at them again.
_caution: Cluster ids come from the fit and are stable only while the seed and the feature blocks are. After a refit that changes k for a hero, re-read docs/ARCHETYPES.md and re-key that hero's entries before trusting them.
